note: Generated from crates/fiducial-identity. Do not edit by hand — run FIDUCIAL_WRITE_VECTORS=1 cargo test -p fiducial-identity --test vectors
rules: deny by default: an empty grant table permits nothing
an unidentified principal is refused (anonymous, or an all-zero sentinel id)
a device may read itself with no grant; it may not write itself
a Platform-scoped grant covers every resource
a role permits every action at or below its own level

scenarios.name: no_grants
scenarios.why: deny is the default; a device may still read itself

scenarios.name: alice_owns_device_a
scenarios.why: the user↔device link: ownership covers one device, not the fleet

scenarios.name: bob_views_device_a
scenarios.why: a shared device: read yes, write no

scenarios.name: member_may_command
scenarios.why: a household member sends commands but cannot re-grant

scenarios.name: service_admin_platform
scenarios.why: a backend service holds a platform-wide grant

scenarios.name: zero_sentinel_is_not_an_identity
scenarios.why: an unprovisioned device must not authenticate as device zero

scenarios.name: device_reports_to_its_owner
scenarios.why: the whole loop: device reads itself, owner reads and commands it

scenarios.name: expired_grant_is_not_a_grant
scenarios.why: a support engineer's access lapses without anyone remembering to revoke it

scenarios.name: unexpired_grant_still_works
scenarios.why: the same grant, before its expiry — the other half of the pair

scenarios.name: no_clock_refuses_an_expiring_grant
scenarios.why: a device with no synced RTC cannot honour an expiry, so it must not honour the grant; the permanent grant beside it is unaffected

scenarios.name: delegated_grant_follows_its_delegator
scenarios.why: alice owns the device and delegates admin to bob; bob's grant is worth exactly what alice's authority is worth

scenarios.name: revoking_the_delegator_revokes_the_delegation
scenarios.why: alice's own grant is gone, so bob's delegated grant stops working without anyone having to find it

scenarios.name: a_member_cannot_delegate_what_they_lack
scenarios.why: delegation needs Admin — the action defined as changing who else may act — so a Member cannot mint grants they could not use

scenarios.name: a_delegation_cycle_terminates
scenarios.why: alice delegated by bob, bob delegated by alice — a table anyone with Admin can write, and an unbounded walk there is a crash in the authorization path

scenarios.name: an_expired_delegator_cannot_sustain_a_delegation
scenarios.why: expiry and delegation compose: the chain is only live while every link in it is
